text:
Ana V: Hi finance, traveled last week to Lisbon and used my personal card for an emergency cash ATM withdrawal when the corp card chip failed. Bank charged a foreign ATM fee + dynamic currency conversion. Total charge = €200.35 but the card shows a USD charge of $214.12 (DCC applied). Can we reimburse the USD amount or do we base on EUR receipt?
Tom G: Hey Ana  sorry about the chip. For international ATM we reimburse actual posted card charge in home currency (USD) unless you provide a local ATM slip showing EUR cash amount and a bank FX receipt showing conversion. Do you have the ATM withdrawal slip?
Ana V: ATM gave only a tiny paper that shows "Cash €200" but no fee breakdown. Bank statement shows USD 214.12 with line "DYN CURR CONV" and a bank FX receipt online that shows conversion rate and fee. Uploading screenshots now.
Finance Bot: Policy: Reimbursements for foreign cash must match either (A) the card posting amount (USD) OR (B) original foreign currency amount with supporting bank FX evidence. If DCC (dynamic currency conversion) was used, employee may be reimbursed full posted USD amount; finance will flag and attempt recovery from vendor if feasible.
Tom G: If you prefer reclaiming the EUR amount to avoid DCC overcharge, provide the ATM slip + bank FX receipt. Finance can also try to dispute the DCC portion with the issuing bank but that takes time. Do you want us to open a dispute?
Ana V: Yes please open a dispute for DCC; I didn't knowingly accept conversion. Also I need immediate reimbursement because statement posts tomorrow. Manager Marta approved the travel.
Marta R: Approved for reimbursement. Please expedite—Ana's card closing tomorrow.
AP Team Bot: We offer 48hr expedited reimbursements for card-exception travel with manager approval. Ana, please file Concur expense, attach ATM slip, bank FX receipt, and bank statement line. Mark "expedite" in notes and CC ap@redwood.com.
Ana V: Filed in Concur, selected expense type "Cash - Foreign ATM" and attached ZIP with screenshots. Marked expedite and CCed AP.
Tom G: Received. We'll process gross reimbursement for posted USD 214.12 as interim. Concurrently opening bank dispute for DCC and vendor follow-up. If dispute recoups DCC, we'll reconcile ledger and notify you.
Finance Bot: Note: If recovered amount posts back, AP will credit to next payroll or offset future expenses as employee prefers. Also cost center used: ENG-TRAVEL-LISBON.
AP Team Bot: Concur submission received. Expedited payout scheduled in 2 business days. Dispute case opened (ref DISC-2025-578).
Ana V: Thanks team. Please ping when dispute outcome known. :pray:
